BCJ.APrivateEntryOnlyYouAnd: A private entry only you and the GM can read
BCJ.AllPlayersCanSeeAndEdit: All players can see and edit this
BCJ.AnEntryEveryoneCanReadSigned: An entry everyone can read, signed with your name
BCJ.AsThePlayersSeeItOpen: As the players see it. Open it in Trackers for hidden parts, GM notes and editing.
BCJ.CampaignJournalAGMNeedsTo: Campaign Journal: a GM needs to be logged in to change who can edit it.
BCJ.CampaignJournalAGMNeedsTo2: Campaign Journal: a GM needs to be logged in for that.
BCJ.CampaignJournalOnlyThePlayerWho: Campaign Journal: only the player who wrote it, or the GM, can change who edits it.
BCJ.CampaignJournalTheGMSClient: Campaign Journal: the GM's client didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
BCJ.CampaignJournalTheHandoutsFolderIsn: Campaign Journal: the Handouts folder isn't there yet.
BCJ.CampaignJournalThePartyFolderIsn: Campaign Journal: the Party folder isn't there yet.
BCJ.CampaignJournalTheQuestSLink: Campaign Journal: the quest's link is copied. Paste it into a journal page.
BCJ.ChooseAPictureToMakeIt: Choose a picture to make it.
BCJ.CopyALinkToThisQuest: Copy a link to this quest to paste into a journal page (or drag the quest from the list)
BCJ.CopyGM: GM copy: everything, GM secrets marked
BCJ.CopyIsInPartyJournal: A copy is in the party journal as "{name}".
BCJ.CopyPlayers: Players' copy: {what}, hidden secrets left out
BCJ.CouldntCopyLink: Campaign Journal: couldn't copy the link. It reads @Quest[{id}].
BCJ.CouldntSaveOrder: Campaign Journal: couldn't save the order ({error}).
BCJ.CouldntSaveWriting: Campaign Journal: couldn't save what you wrote ({error}).
BCJ.DateNotKnown: Campaign Journal: "{typed}" isn't a date the calendar knows; {what}.
BCJ.DeleteText: Delete {name} from {where}? This can't be undone.
BCJ.DownloadThisEntryAsAMarkdown: Download this entry as a Markdown file
BCJ.DownloadThisTabSEntriesAs: Download this tab's entries as one Markdown file
BCJ.DraftKept: What you were writing in {name} couldn't be saved. It's kept in this browser: open the entry and use Write here to get it back.
BCJ.EmptyGM: Entries in the Campaign Journal folder show here: Party for the party journal, Handouts for handouts (who can see each one is its own permission), and each player's folder under Players for their journal.
BCJ.EveryPlayerCanEditItAnd: Every player can edit it and add to it
BCJ.EveryPlayerCanReadItPlayers: Every player can read it, players who join later too
BCJ.EveryoneWillBeAbleToRead: Everyone will be able to read the copy; you can still edit it
BCJ.FoldersBeingMade: The journal's folders are being made.
BCJ.GiveItATitleToMake: Give it a title to make it.
BCJ.InThePartyJournal: Campaign Journal: "{name}" is in the party journal.
BCJ.IncludingAnythingTheRestOfThe: , including anything the rest of the party added to it
BCJ.KeepItAtTheTopOf: Keep it at the top of the party journal
BCJ.KeyOpenHint: Opens the journal window, or brings it to the front.
BCJ.LetTheRestEdit: Let the rest of the party edit it too
BCJ.MoveItDownAmongThePinned: Move it down among the pinned entries
BCJ.MoveItUpAmongThePinned: Move it up among the pinned entries
BCJ.NewPageInThePartyJournal: New page in the party journal, such as Lines and Veils or house rules
BCJ.NoHandoutsYet: No handouts yet. Use + Handout to make one.
BCJ.NoPlayerCanReadThisEntry: No player can read this entry, so the players' copy would be empty.
BCJ.NoPlayersYet: No players yet. Each player's journal shows here once they have a user.
BCJ.NoQuestsYetMakeThemIn: No quests yet. Make them in Campaign Trackers.
BCJ.NoReaderLoggedIn: No player who can read "{name}" is logged in.
BCJ.NoReaderOnlyYou: No player who can read "{name}" is logged in, so only you see it.
BCJ.NoShortVersion: "{name}" has no short version to show.
BCJ.NothingHereYetUseStrongNew: Nothing here yet. Use New entry to start your private journal; only you and the GM can read it.
BCJ.NothingInThePartyJournalYet: Nothing in the party journal yet. Recaps and pages the GM shares show here, and New party entry writes one everyone can read.
BCJ.NothingOnThisTabIsShared: Nothing on this tab is shared with every player, so the players' copy would be empty.
BCJ.NothingOnThisTabToExport: Nothing on this tab to export.
BCJ.NothingToReadYet: This entry has nothing to read yet.
BCJ.NothingWrittenYetUseNewEntry: Nothing written yet. Use New entry to start.
BCJ.OnlyAnEntryInYourOwn: only an entry in your own journal can be shared.
BCJ.OnlyGMsWillSeeItAnyone: Only GMs will see it (anyone you made Owner keeps it)
BCJ.OnlyTheAuthorAndTheGM: Only the author and the GM can edit it
BCJ.OnlyYouAndGMNow: Campaign Journal: only you and the GM can edit "{name}" now.
BCJ.OnlyYouAndGMRead: Only you and the GM can read it.
BCJ.OpenItOnTheScreensOf: Open it on the screens of the players who can read it
BCJ.OtherPageType: This page ({type}) opens in Foundry's own viewer.
BCJ.PartyCanEditNow: Campaign Journal: the party can edit "{name}" now.
BCJ.PartyCanEditToo: The party can edit it too
BCJ.PartyEntryNote: Everyone can read it, signed with your name. You can change who edits it later.
BCJ.PinItToTop: Pin it to the top of the party journal
BCJ.PlayersCanTSeeThisQuest: Players can't see this quest yet. Open it in Trackers to write it or reveal it.
BCJ.PutItBackInItsPlace: Put it back in its place in the party journal
BCJ.QuestNotOpen: This quest isn't open to you.
BCJ.QuestsMadeInCampaignTrackersShow: Quests made in Campaign Trackers show here as the players see them.
BCJ.RecapPastePlaceholder: Paste the recap here, or import the file. Leave it empty for a blank recap to write in.
BCJ.ReplaceSharedCopy: Replace "{name}" in the party journal with this version
BCJ.SaveWhatYouWroteAndGo: Save what you wrote and go back to reading
BCJ.SessionDatesAndWhoPlayedIf: Session, dates and who played if left blank
BCJ.SessionDatesAndWhoWasAt: Session, dates and who was at the table
BCJ.SettingShowFolderHint: Show the Campaign Journal folder in players' Journal tab. Off keeps their tab clean: they read everything in the journal window.
BCJ.ShareACopyToTheParty: Share a copy to the Party Journal
BCJ.ShareAgainText: You shared this before. Replace the copy in the party journal, {name}, with this version? What it says now will be overwritten{more}.
BCJ.ShareText: Put a copy of {name} in the party journal, signed with your name? Everyone will be able to read it. You can still edit the copy, and your own entry stays private.
BCJ.ShowTheJournalSFoldersIn: Show the journal's folders in the Journal tab
BCJ.ShowTheShortVersionToThe: Show the short version to the players who can read it
BCJ.TakenFromTheFileIfLeft: Taken from the file if left blank
BCJ.TakenFromTheFileIfLeft2: Taken from the file if left blank; otherwise the session, dates and who played
BCJ.TemplateRecapShort: The whole session in a paragraph.
BCJ.ThatSNoLongerInThe: That's no longer in the world.
BCJ.TheDateWasKeptAsIt: the date was kept as it was
BCJ.ThePartyJournalIsnTThere: the party journal isn't there yet. Ask the GM.
BCJ.TheSharedCopyIsnTYours: the shared copy isn't yours to change any more. Ask the GM.
BCJ.Title: Campaign Journal
BCJ.WaitingMany: Campaign Journal: {n} entries are new or updated since you last looked.
BCJ.WaitingOne: Campaign Journal: 1 entry is new or updated since you last looked.
BCJ.WriteInThisEntryWithoutLeaving: Write in this entry without leaving the journal
BCJ.YourJournalFolderIsnTThere: your journal folder isn't there yet. Ask the GM.
